0022600143.text: The Clippers (1-2, 8th in the West) host the Lakers (3-0, 1st in the Pacific), who have one more game to play before this one, and Los Angeles is 1-0 at home but 0-2 on the road and on a two-game losing streak. The Clippers are without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (plantar fasciitis), Rui Hachimura (quadriceps soreness), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), while the Lakers are missing Adou Thiero (knee inflammation). The Clippers trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 125-117 in Los Angeles on October 23, and the teams split their 2025-26 series 2-2.
